metadata.title: Inference Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting AI inference interfaces from abuse, leakage, extraction, and unsafe or excessive use.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI inference endpoints, APIs, interactive query interfaces, and generative service surfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how access to AI inference is authorized, constrained, monitored, and defended against abuse and extraction.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides adversary-centric context for abuse of exposed services, denial-of-service, and resource exhaustion via AI inference interfaces.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat taxonomy for model extraction, membership inference, prompt abuse, and inference-time attacks.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.value: Model Extraction and Intellectual Property Theft
props.remarks: Threats where attackers reconstruct model behavior or parameters through repeated or adaptive querying.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats involving excessive, recursive, or adversarial inference requests that exhaust resources or incur excessive cost.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where sensitive training data membership or attributes are inferred through inference responses.

metadata.remarks: Inference Protection defines how AI systems expose inference capabilities in a controlled and defendable manner. This pattern exists to mitigate AI-native risks such as model extraction, inference abuse, membership inference, and economic denial-of-service that arise from unrestricted or poorly governed querying.

components.title: Inference Access Controls
components.description: Authorization controls defining who or what may invoke AI inference and under what conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI inference endpoints are accessible only to authenticated and authorized identities with approved purposes.

components.title: Rate Limiting and Usage Controls
components.description: Constraining the volume, frequency, and pattern of inference requests to prevent abuse and extraction.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Inference usage is throttled and monitored to prevent model extraction, denial-of-wallet, and abusive querying patterns.

components.title: Output Safeguards and Response Shaping
components.description: Controls applied to inference responses to limit leakage, over-precision, or harmful output patterns.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI inference responses are shaped or constrained to reduce the risk of leakage, extraction, or unsafe disclosure.
